description: 4 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-27 under road-to-database-relational-modeling 2.2, which removed this skill from the trigger-eval grandfather list. Exemplars cover the rollout-shaping request in its explicit forms (phases, dual-write, deprecation) and a German phrasing. Near-misses are the three neighbours the skill's own body routes away to: authoring a single additive migration (laravel-migration), reviewing a migration diff for scale hazards (schema-review), and designing the target schema itself (database, relational modeling reference). Counterexamples guard the 'migration' homonym (data migration between hosting providers, a package major-version upgrade).

queries.q: plan the rollout for splitting the users.name column into first_name and last_name without downtime
we need a dual-write window while we move orders to a new table — how do we sequence the cutover?
design the deprecation cycle for the legacy status column that three services still read
wie rollen wir die Schemaänderung über mehrere Deploys aus, ohne die Consumer zu brechen?
create a migration that adds a nullable notes column to invoices
review this migration diff for missing indexes before I merge
how should I model users that belong to several projects with a role each?
migrate our hosting from Heroku to AWS
upgrade the project from Laravel 11 to Laravel 12
